string.value: I don't understand. I have photos here on my desk, which are a month old. There wasn't any jungle there, not even a trace.
We know where professor Pappers is, so it's just about getting him out alive and well.
Agent, can you hear me? Do you copy? Switch to the extra range! Copy? Agent, do you copy?
Agent, if you can hear me, press the receive button twice. Aha, great! It seems this place is a dead zone…
As soon as you get the professor out… (static)… On exit from the canyon, you will meet… (static) Do you copy?.. (static)
Just don't get under fire from Delta, while you rescuing the professor from the smugglers.
You came to save me? Oh, perfect thing, perfect thing! So, my government finally decided to save me from bandits.
However, I already escaped from bandits myself, oh yes I did! Military men were chasing them, so they all had no time to care about me. And I got out without your help, really.
We have managed to activate the surveillance satellite
It looks like the bandit camp is near to you. There's some big hut-shaped tents, and there's a possibility the professor is being kept in one of them.
We didn't notice any traces of combat nearby. In any case, you need to examine the place.
Don't think I'm coming with you, though! The smugglers have my samples and research materials, yes they do.
I ain't going nowhere without them. It's many years of work, all right? Take my papers back from the bandits and I'm coming with you, and not otherwise!
The bandits retreat from the military, heading to the swamps. You are still able to get them.
Your truck is well protected from radiation, which is a very bad thing.
I mean it's good, but it's bad because the armor is heavy, and the place is swampy, yes it is. That's because of the swamp.
ON-BOARD COMPUTER|The object images from surveillance satellite camera are not tents. They are giant eggs. Presumably bird eggs.
